To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
OCR for Braille is a challenging problem and the existing OCR for Braille has many issues to be addressed.
the optical braille recognition is the most challenging task.
Optical Braille recognition system can be effectively/efficiently translated into text by applying different algorithms and techniques.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing and improving Optical Braille Recognition systems.
the development and evaluation of a Braille recognition algorithm for the conversion of Brailledocuments to digital text.
the study of various algorithms and techniques used for Optical Braille Recognition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the existing Optical Braille recognition systems are not yet fully automated and are not able to achieve 100% accuracy in translating Braille to text.
there is still a lot to be done to achieve a perfect OCR system for Braille.
, the Optical Braille Recognition systems are still at its initial phase of research and development and a lot of scope for improvisation is still available in terms of accuracy and efficiency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have surveyed and compared various algorithms proposed and presented by various researchers in improvising optical Braille recognition system to effectively/ efficiently translate Braille to Text.
we are able to provide a comparative study on the various techniques used for Optical Braille Recognition.
, we are going to implement an Optical Braille Recognition System that will help visually challenged people to convert their hardcopy Braille to text.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no single technique which is best suited for Optical Braille Recognition.
the Optical Braille Recognition systems have been implemented in various domains and have been successfully tested and validated.
the Optical Braille recognition system can be effectively implemented with the help of various image processing techniques.
